limitations: Inspected all 48 supplied neutral images using view_image: desktop-full, mobile-full, desktop-review and mobile-failure/cart for each of twelve views, in packet view order. Read only instructions.md, neutral-packet.json and its referenced images before submission.

Read task/fixture contracts, original initial/decision geometry and desktop/mobile scripted traces. Repeated task texts were checked identical within task families. Geometry describes original placement, not proof of ease or quality.

No authored styling, axe observations, source code, manifest, gallery, other review or prior study inspected. Neutral CSS can remove color-only states and alter wrapping; blank LIN-115 visuals and subdued selections must be revisited only in the separately released authored stage.

Screenshots cover 1440px desktop and 390px mobile selected states; 320px provides only width/scrollWidth/pageHeight metadata. No live interaction or full keyboard/accessibility audit performed; scripted passes do not establish comprehension, usability or conformance.

Inventory inspect evidence and many empty/invalid/success states are primarily trace-backed rather than separately pictured. Commerce care/returns accordions in view-11 were not shown expanded. Transfer traces preserve failure summaries but explicitly do not separately exercise editing after failure.
